name: What is the typical cost range for stone veneer installation in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost range for stone veneer installation in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of stone veneer installation in the Los Angeles area can vary significantly based on several factors. These include the type of veneer selected (natural vs. manufactured, specific stone style), the complexity of the installation (e.g., intricate cuts, corners, arches), the total square footage, and necessary surface preparation. General ranges often fall between $15 to $40 per square foot, including materials and labor. For an accurate estimate tailored to your specific project and property, we recommend scheduling a free consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Los Angeles, stone veneer installation costs typically range from $15 to $40 per square foot, depending on veneer type, project complexity, and total area. A custom quote requires a site assessment.
